propositions: Whole-tree fixture helpers export all 3,019 checkout files when production hatch_build.py requires only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py, causing avoidable repeated builds in xdist workers.

Artifact-probe workflow uses GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving git rev-parse --short HEAD from final checkout and asserts truthiness rather than exact SHA equality, accepting wrong nonempty provenance on patchsets.

Production hatch_build.py on a minimal committed Hatch package preserves exact SHA identity for env override, Git fallback, blank-env failure, and sdist preservation while reducing paired build times from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.
Xdist runtime tracing proves session fixture initializes independently on all three workers at 6.60–6.74s setup each, demonstrating three full PEP 517 builds instead of one shared replay.
Both artifact workflow lanes must build from final checkout with exact-SHA equality enforcement for wheel and sdist artifacts.
